reviewer.display_name: AI-assisted translation and adversarial preflight (not a human reviewer)

findings.explanation: The elevated phrase Lạc Thú Chỉ Lưu Lại Một Khoảnh Khắc remains long and slightly unusual; compare aloud with the conservative earlier version before approval.
Điều đã chết preserves the unnamed referent but strains ordinary Vietnamese collocation. Compare thứ đã chết without turning the referent into a named person or gender.
Replaced the rhetorical expansion phó nó cho ngọn lửa with trao nó cho lửa; this keeps the source’s simple, ritual giving and parallel And clauses.

summary: AI-assisted revision and adversarial preflight only, covering all five passages. Retained repeated bronze/world/image, restored paragraph-three And, removed editorial explanatory dashes, and rejected Chỉ Còn after detecting an added residual-time implication. The earlier historical 8.6 self-assessment is preserved. This revision is also provisionally 8.6: it improves specific defects without evidence that the unresolved allegorical cadence and unnamed dead thing now meet publication-grade Vietnamese. No human reviewer, identity, independence, license permission or approval is asserted.
